about: lib/whose.ts: albumMine over every combination of its inputs - [personal, starred, storeDone, bridgeFailed, bridgeYours (null: not sent), present, release, releaseSaid, changed] -> [yours, badge, action, note (by its name in words), pending]; whose.sim.cjs's cases by name; heldPhrase and heldLabel; the words; the mine block's button and placeholder, and `wired`: the album page's state (the album's answer or none, its error, the id bridge's answer - present as a count - or its failure, the last change) turned into albumMine's inputs as AlbumPage.tsx does it, and what albumMine says, with `shown`: whether the page draws the badge, the unseen placeholder and the mine block from it - the last two [with no refusal, with one] (AlbumPage.tsx, evaluated as written).
made_by: ios/scripts/export-screen-vectors.cjs - never edit by hand: change the TypeScript and run it again

words.ADD_FROM_PAGE: It's already here - add it to your library to keep it with your music.
words.REMOVED_FROM_PAGE: Removed from your library - it's still in the collection, and nothing was deleted.
words.REMOVED_STAR_TO_RETURN: Removed from your library - it's still in the collection, and nothing was deleted. To add it back, make it a favourite in another music app.
words.NO_RELEASE_TO_ADD: This album can't be added from here - make it a favourite in another music app, and it joins your library.
words.NOT_FOUND_TO_ADD: This album can't be added from here yet - make it a favourite in another music app, and it joins your library.

sim.name: logins off: "In your library", nothing offered - as it always was
the store's, not yours: "In the collection" and Add to my library, with what Add does
yours by the bridge, or starred by you: "In your library" and Remove
...starred by the album's own answer even before the bridge has answered
not yours with no release id to keep it by: no Add, and the line says why
...nor with a release the store has no folder of - and the line says that, never "no release id" (review)
the bridge unable to say (a folder, no `yours`): "In the collection" - true either way - and nothing offered
...nor once the bridge has FAILED - never the "no release id" line for a check that couldn't be made (review)
...nor when the bridge found no release where Navidrome names one
...nor before the bridge has answered - said to be on its way, so its place is held
...nor before the album's own answer - a list's tile is never read for `starred` (review: one from before a Remove)
an Add just taken: "In your library", the added words, Remove to undo it
a Remove just taken: "In the collection", saying nothing was deleted, Add to undo it - even over a stale `starred`
...but no Add after removing an album deadwax can't keep - and the line says how to have it back (review)
